about.intro_content: Prof. Hai-Qiang Mai is Assistant President of Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC) and Director of its Department of Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma in Guangzhou, China. He is a Chief Physician, Professor and Doctoral Advisor specialising in NPC early diagnosis and individualized combination therapy.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Mai's research centres on prognosis prediction and individualized treatment for nasopharyngeal carcinoma, and he has served as Principal Investigator on national research programmes including the National Science Fund for Distinguished Young Scholars since 2006. He has published more than 80 peer-reviewed papers in journals including The Lancet Oncology, Journal of Clinical Oncology, Journal of the National Cancer Institute and Clinical Cancer Research. His honours include the Cancer Science Young Scientists Award (Japan, 2006) and recognition as an Excellent Talent of the Ministry of Education in the New Century (2012).

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Hai-Qiang Mai

items.question: Does Prof. Hai-Qiang Mai accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to nasopharyngeal carcinoma at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Mai's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Mai specialises in nasopharyngeal carcinoma, with a particular focus on early diagnosis, individualized combination therapy, and prognosis prediction based on EBV DNA and other biomarkers.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Is Prof. Mai involved in clinical trials for nasopharyngeal carcinoma?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Mai has led multiple national research grants and phase III clinical trials in NPC and continues to serve as Principal Investigator on active studies at SYSUCC.

items.question: What makes Prof. Mai's approach to NPC distinctive?
items.answer: Prof. Mai's work emphasises individualizing treatment based on EBV DNA levels and validated prognostic nomograms, aiming to tailor combination therapy to each patient's risk profile rather than a one-size-fits-all approach.
